definitions.short: Eljehoenai or Eljoenai , the name of seven Israelites
definitions.full: H454. Elyhow 'eynay אֶלְיְהוֺעֵינַי proper name, masculine ( unto ׳י are mine eyes ) 1 a Korahite 1Chr 26:3 . 2 a returning exile Ezra 8:4 . אֶלְיוֺעֵינַי proper name, masculine ( id. ) 1 a descendant of David 1Chr 3:23-24 ,. 2 a Simeonite אֶלְיוֺעֵנַי 1Chr 4:36 . 3 a Benjamite ( id. ) 1Chr 7:8 . 4 priests in time of Ezra ( a ) Ezra 10:22 ; ( b ) 10:27 ( אֶלְיוֺעֵנַי ); ( c ) Neh 12:41 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
